description: Analyses and optionally adjusts the tonal distribution of an image. mode=none passes the image through unchanged and just outputs the histogram visualisation and stats. equalize applies global histogram equalisation. clahe uses OpenCV's Contrast Limited AHE (requires opencv-python-headless). stretch linearly remaps the darkest and brightest pixels to 0 and 1. The histogram_image output is a (1, vis_height, vis_width, 3) tensor you can connect to a Preview Image node.
